55:17.text: Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.

55:18.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

55:20.text: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.

55:21.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

55:22.text: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

55:23.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

55:24.text: And to Him belong the ships
elevated in the sea like mountains.

55:25.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

55:27.text: And there will remain the Face
of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
